Loading libraries
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```

# Problem 1

```{r}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

Details of the dataset:

The dataset is describing the various species of penguins found in various islands, their bill length, bill depth, flipper length, body mass and sex.

The number of different species available in this dataset is `r length(unique(penguins$species))`. They are: `r unique(penguins$species)`.

The number of rows in the dataset is `r nrow(penguins)` and the number of columns is `r ncol(penguins)`. 

The mean flipper length is `r round(mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE))` mm.

Scatterplot of flipper length vs bill length:

```{r}
ggplot(penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = flipper_length_mm, 
                     colour = species)) + 
	geom_point()
```
